mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market with unemployment below 4.5% and monthly job growth exceeding 100k (PAYEMS > 100k) indicates late-cycle expansion, triggering anticipated monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 100k over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 100.0 for two consecutive months signals economic contraction, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 for two consecutive months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1,000.0 thousand units annually indicates strong housing market activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through consumer confidence and economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars consistently reflects strong consumer spending, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenues rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 50th percentile over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 2.0% signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings visibility and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 2.0% over a 3-year rolling window.
